articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin edges higher as Nasdaq surges 1.2%
articles.snippet: The Fed is expected to hold rates steady on Wednesday, but markets will be looking for clues about future policy moves.

articles.title: Crypto wallet maker Keystone to destroy almost 19,000 devices after security breach
articles.snippet: The breach exposed 25,964 buyer records, some kept past Keystone’s 180-day deletion policy after an automated tool failed without the firm noticing.

articles.title: Majority of Americans want candidates who support US-based financial technology: Poll
articles.snippet: The September survey offered a possible window into US voters who could consider fintech and digital asset policies on Election Day.

articles.title: NBA names Kalshi, Polymarket preferred exchanges, signs CFTC deal
articles.snippet: The US professional basketball league is expanding into prediction markets with official data agreements and safeguards against insider trading.

articles.title: South Korea lawmakers mull pushing crypto tax implementation to 2029
articles.snippet: The Seoul government is reportedly weighing another delay for a 2020 income tax policy on digital assets, citing concerns with receiving data from US officials.
